'''2005 U.S. National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship in Columbus, Ohio (2 July 2005, at Origins).<ref name="pc-events05">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing (updated 27 June 2005)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 28 August 2005.</ref> [[Reid Smith]] and [[Brandon Ruck]] won its two Day 2 byes, and Smith won the opportunity to design a virtual card.<ref name="pc-events05" /> It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Columbus, Ohio
* '''Dates:''' 2 July 2005 (Origins)<ref name="pc-events05" />
